recommendation: Keep this external-repo audit as-is for core. If future wording or cardinality corrections are needed for derivation-reference, make them in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than in HL7/fhir.
issue_request: FHIR-34475 was a Published FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking for a new extension originally proposed as annotation-reference and accepted as derivation-reference. The accepted extension has Resource and Element context, reference/path/offset/length children, and a constraint that length cannot appear when offset is missing.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in core by c40e1884516595dfcbf61825390227448516ab29, which added source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-extension-structuredefinition-derivation-reference.xml with the accepted name, contexts, children, and constraint. The later core-wide commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed extension definitions from R5 core source, including this extension.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and Zulip discussion confirm the tracker vote, the rename to derivation-reference, the use of path and offset to point to text content in any resource, and the correction to keep Resource-level context. Current core source has no derivation-reference StructureDefinition and only retains the OID registration in source/oids.ini; the active StructureDefinition is in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-derivation-reference.xml.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. Reintroducing the extension definition into core would duplicate the Extension Pack source of truth and conflict with the current build-scope split.
